sources.title: gemma 3 12b it abliterated — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A mid-sized multimodal model that has had its refusal behaviors removed through abliteration, meaning it responds to sensitive or edgy prompts without the usual safety guardrails. It retains Gemma 3 12B's solid reasoning and image understanding capabilities, but operates without content filters — making it more permissive but also less predictable on harmful content.
